quality_floor.purpose: A reusable quality floor for blog drafts; it is not a ranking guarantee.

rules: Name the concrete subject and reader task without hiding the answer behind clickbait.
Use a current date or policy qualifier only when it is verified and materially useful.
Keep one main intent in the title; put secondary keywords in the introduction or headings.

article: Answer the reader's main question near the beginning.
Use short paragraphs, clear section hierarchy and a visible next step.
Record the market, language, observation date and source ledger for material claims.
Separate sourced facts, user experience and editorial inference.
Keep numbers, labels, links and policy conditions faithful to their sources.
visual: Choose a concrete visual job before choosing a template.
Keep required labels readable at mobile width and leave a safe crop margin.
Use real source or user-authorized images for evidence; never invent an app screen or statistic.
Remove personal data from screenshots and preserve provenance for every asset.
Inspect the actual asset at full size and at a 375px-wide preview before handoff.
boundaries: A style profile changes presentation guidance, not search ranking rules.
No profile promises exposure, clicks, citations or a particular model response.
Reference traits are abstracted; private URLs, images and account identifiers are never bundled.

balanced-editorial.label: 균형 잡힌 정보형
balanced-editorial.description: A neutral, readable baseline for new blogs and unfamiliar topics.

visual.composition: subject-led editorial or one-message social card
visual.annotations: only when they explain a real object or step

keep: supporting images beside the prose they clarify
avoid: tiny footnotes or long paragraphs inside images
generic decorative icons standing in for evidence
uncertain: whether a visual treatment improves exposure cannot be inferred without a controlled comparison

tactile-howto.label: 촉감형 단계 안내
tactile-howto.description: An optional personal profile for warm, practical Korean how-to posts with a handmade editorial feel.

visual.headline: one short handwritten-style phrase, never a paragraph
visual.composition: a tactile cover or real screenshot in a clean paper frame
visual.annotation: one coral circle or arrow that points to the exact control or fact
visual.series_rule: Keep palette and type treatment consistent while varying crop and composition
visual.provenance: Use actual user-authorized or official source screenshots for procedures; never redraw UI with a model

keep: short centered prose blocks with a strong section rhythm
a square cover that establishes the topic without repeating the whole article
one 4:5 step image for each genuinely distinct action
real source screenshots framed with generous whitespace and a clear callout
small tables or checklists when a reader must compare thresholds or verify completion
a freshness note that states the date and warns that policy or screens can change
avoid: a beige template applied to unrelated topics
PPT-like grids, dense bullets or tiny text
made-up app controls, logos, badges, numbers or testimonials
copying a reference image, layout or distinctive artwork
using the personal profile as proof of ranking or engagement causality
uncertain: the observed search inflow is a small post-level sample and does not isolate the image effect
handwritten accents may reduce legibility for a different audience or topic
